insight: Founded in Amsterdam in 2019 under the name SeMI Technologies; raised a $50M Series B led by Index Ventures in 2023.
name: Weaviate
tagline: Open-source vector database with built-in vectorisers.
description: Cloud-native vector DB that can compute embeddings inline — pass raw text in, store vectors out. Strong hybrid (BM25 + vector) search; self-hostable or managed.
edge: Built-in vectorizers embed text inline — raw text in, vectors out — plus hybrid BM25 + vector search out of the box.
cons: Module config has a learning curve
